notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
-More air control while jumping
-More hangtime to help with javelin accuracy
-Faster sword swing/javelin throw
-Music no longer stops on Cliff level
-Fixed rendering issue creating random lines
-Title/Game menu now has controller support
